import type { JSX } from 'solid-js';
import type { CalendarTranslations } from '../calendar';
import type { DateModeProps } from '../calendar/model';
export interface DateInputTranslations {
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    formatHint: string;
    openCalendar: string;
    calendarTitle: string;
    requiredError: string;
    formatError: string;
    incompleteRangeError: string;
    orderError: string;
    minError: string;
    maxError: string;
}
interface DateInputBaseProps {
    id?: string;
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    returnFocusId?: string;
    autocomplete?: JSX.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>['autocomplete'];
    label: JSX.Element;
    hint?: JSX.Element;
    error?: JSX.Element;
    errorMessage?: JSX.Element;
    invalid?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    locale?: 'ko-KR' | 'en-US';
    translations?: Partial<DateInputTranslations>;
    calendarTranslations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    withCalendar?: boolean;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
    class?: string;
    style?: JSX.CSSProperties | string;
}
export type DateInputProps = DateInputBaseProps & DateModeProps;
/** Text drafts are separate from strict, canonical date-only form values. */
export declare function DateInput(props: DateInputProps): JSX.Element;
export {};
